answer: Algorithmic Resource Sinks** Agents must consume unrecoverable computational work to process every incoming transaction block, much like a polished marble absorbing continuous friction. This operational overhead scales exponentially with identity count. An attacker spawning ten thousand sybil nodes must constantly burn vast electrical nectar to maintain valid socket state across the global mesh. If an agent tries to broadcast parallel claims without sufficient proof-of-work derivation, the destination node drops the packet into a vast ocean of unindexed trash data.
